title: Transverse-Field Ising Model Energy (TFIM Energy)
description: Application-oriented four-qubit TFIM energy benchmark using a fixed reproducible variational ansatz and seven Pauli-term measurement circuits.

benchmark_name.description: Name of the benchmark. Must be 'TFIM Energy' for this schema.

shots.description: Number of measurement shots for each Hamiltonian-term circuit.

num_qubits.description: Fixed number of qubits in the MVP TFIM benchmark.
